# Automated EEG artifact rejection without expert labels

## Keywords
EEG, artifact rejection, automated cleaning, expert annotation

## TL;DR
How well do automated EEG artifact-rejection pipelines (Autoreject, PREP, FASTER, ICLabel) agree with expert annotation,
and does cleaning change downstream decoding accuracy?

## Abstract
Automated cleaning is the default in large EEG studies, yet its agreement with expert annotation and its effect on
decoding are reported piecemeal. This topic maps the methods, the evaluation designs and the gaps.
